verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage exposes its own generic transaction API that creates a transaction and runs payment screening and transaction monitoring, with an OpenAPI schema covering transaction resources. That implies transactions can be submitted from any stack rather than tied to one processor, but the evidence never explicitly says it is processor-agnostic. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of PSP/gateway-agnostic ingestion, named integrations or connectors for multiple PSPs, gateways or platforms, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-processor use.
